title: Unicode scalar CP1252 mapping
summary: Recover the ECX scalar to EAX mapping at 0x5c2380: 27 special Unicode values map to CP1252 codes and all other 32-bit values pass through. The caller at 0x5c259e applies a separate range check.
test_description: Compare directly to the original for the entire BMP, supplementary and invalid boundaries, and 10000 deterministic 32-bit values. Install FS and check its head after each original call; the routine has no object fields or memory writes.
known_limits: The portable C++ entry point uses the normal C++ calling convention; the original uses ECX for its scalar.
The caller's conversion and replacement policy is outside this recovered routine.
